description.html: This 75x40x60 cm terrarium (180 L) is made of quality glass and covered on the outside with film of your choice. The film gives the terrarium a neat look that fits your interior, with wood, bamboo and marble patterns or solid black or white available.

A length of 75 cm and a width of 40 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. On this floor area you can easily set up a basking spot and a cool side, the basis of proper reptile care. We fit every terrarium with ventilation mesh that provides airflow suited to the species you keep.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote.
